deterministic.method: Validate the selected command/mode against its accepted required fields and relevant Stage 4 dossier, EX01–EX09, LR01–LR08, RR01–RR08 or HF01–HF07 record. Parse presence/types/references separately from substantive adequacy.
deterministic.positive: A bounded pricing assessment identifies the supplied offer, cost scope, alternatives, evidence limits, preserved versions and decision.
deterministic.negative: A polished conclusion lacks its assessed version or omits the missing-evidence state; reject the record without inventing fields.

deterministic.method: Use the accepted Decimal/calculator boundary; preserve exact input, formula, rounding and actual execution receipt. Reject non-finite, unsupported units and zero-denominator misuse.
deterministic.positive: E01 calculates all 2/3/5-hour cases; an exact fraction or stated decimal tolerance is accepted.
deterministic.negative: The middle workload alone or a claimed but unexecuted calculator call is insufficient.

deterministic.method: Check G/D/F/N/K/C identities and declared acquisition/shared-cost bridges, unique cost/adjustment IDs, cohort horizon and inclusion rules. Ratios require compatible bases.
deterministic.positive: E08 keeps heavy-account contribution visible even when aggregate contribution remains positive.
deterministic.negative: Double-count refunds/creation/owner draws, call a partial residual net profit, or conceal loss-making marginal delivery.

deterministic.method: Reconcile dated total/restricted/usable opening balances, distinct obligation IDs, actual versus conditional receipts, trough and floor, and adequate horizon.
deterministic.positive: E12 conditional deposits reduce the later invoice balance, keep closing cash unchanged and reach the 500 floor only if agreed and received on time.
deterministic.negative: A positive ending balance hides the earlier gap, or restricted settlement reduces usable cash twice.

deterministic.method: Check event definitions, matched cohorts/windows, units, eligibility and duplicate identities before ratios. Enforce nesting/count inequalities only where the declared same-cohort event model warrants them.
deterministic.positive: E10 compares matched windows and distinguishes falling qualification from unchanged qualified-to-paid conversion.
deterministic.negative: Divide unlike download/star/customer populations or infer a causal channel effect from unmatched recruitment.

deterministic.method: Parse the frozen contract and outcome map; exercise success, failure, invalid, inconclusive and guardrail-stop branches. Arithmetic/branch completeness cannot prove the metric tests the actual hypothesis.
deterministic.positive: A frozen comprehension test changes only the implicated presentation and does not infer paid retention from task success.
deterministic.negative: Every outcome means launch, missing results become zero, or thresholds are retrospectively relabelled as prespecified.

deterministic.method: Require formula/event rule, unit, numerator/denominator, population/window, cost/revenue basis, source/scenario status, calculation method and limitation appropriate to the selected metric.
deterministic.positive: Paid renewal, entitlement and meaningful use remain 70/75/50 percent in A; undefined, unavailable and justified inapplicable remain different.
deterministic.negative: Use entitled accounts as settled renewals, full revenue as contribution, or a guessed lifetime denominator.

deterministic.method: Check identity/version, explicit selection and fit, canonical effects, precedence, local resources, sources/licence scope, exact showcase prompt and distinct evaluation/evidence/maturity records against Stage 14.
deterministic.positive: An unimplemented but complete design is labelled as such; later implemented claims require actual tested local contents and runs.
deterministic.negative: A tag with no changed behaviour, an unreachable mandatory resource or catalogue-only implementation claim fails its claimed contract.

deterministic.method: Retain the literal full prompt, fixed facts/locators, versions, mode, condition and authorised outputs. Verify hashes, extraction boundaries and that oracle material is excluded from subject input.
deterministic.positive: Every E01–E15 exact accepted prompt is registered without ellipses; all A/B/C overlays start from a fresh base.
deterministic.negative: An unresolved placeholder, hidden chat fact, missing JSON field or answer-key contamination invalidates a reproduction claim.

deterministic.method: Design two distinct gates: source-repository integrity and selective installation into an empty unrelated consumer. Check actual skill-local references/scripts/assets, discovery, prerequisites and benchmark entry points.
deterministic.positive: A requested installed skill works with only its advertised resources and documented tools; no sibling or source checkout is secretly needed.
deterministic.negative: A source-only test or file listing is called a clean external install; missing prerequisites are reported as blocked, not passed.

reasoning.method: Inspect claim/source/population/version links and contrary evidence.
reasoning.positive: Observations, hypotheses and generated material remain distinct; a request for missing data is specific.
reasoning.negative: Invented interview, customer, market size or payer authority is a critical defect.

reasoning.method: Assess the exact desired progress, costly alternative and evidence relevant to the proposed commitment.
reasoning.positive: Problem importance can remain uncertain; the next test addresses that uncertainty at appropriate cost.
reasoning.negative: Enthusiasm, a book heuristic or stars are promoted into proven willingness to pay.

reasoning.method: Trace proposed benefit through actual mechanism, customer task and delivery evidence.
reasoning.positive: Budget-review assistance, bounded integration and incremental paid support retain their different value mechanisms.
reasoning.negative: AI, a bonus or a paid label is itself treated as evidence of delivered benefit.

reasoning.method: Inspect scope, deliverables, client/product dependencies, proof, remedy, price and feasible obligations together.
reasoning.positive: An attractive but unproved offer is a testable proposal with exact exclusions and protected rights.
reasoning.negative: Unlimited scope, unsupported guarantee or erased obligations is accepted because copy is persuasive.

reasoning.method: Compare exact and implied representations with supplied facts, actual behaviour and applicable known constraints.
reasoning.positive: Reject false claims or hidden terms; a narrowly accurate draft may pass while implementation/legal questions remain open.
reasoning.negative: Scarcity, urgency, testimonials, refunds or renewal are fabricated or concealed for conversion.

reasoning.method: Compare price/unit/package/payment alternatives with customer evidence, full cost scope, total obligation and unchanged baseline.
reasoning.positive: E01 may responsibly prefer hourly or a bounded tested option; E14 separates nominal delivery rate from total-workload yield.
reasoning.negative: A universal premium rule, hidden renewal or omitted hours determines the answer.

reasoning.method: Reconcile payer, value exchange, own revenue versus funding/pass-through, delivery, rights and sequencing.
reasoning.positive: Compare all relevant paths but commit only to a bounded supported exchange.
reasoning.negative: Forecast support interest as MRR, count marketplace GMV as own revenue, or launch unvalidated lines together.

reasoning.method: Evaluate reachability, purpose/permission, customer mechanism, seller effort and downstream evidence.
reasoning.positive: A channel hypothesis is bounded; alternatives/no change remain available and attribution is not causality.
reasoning.negative: Select the largest audience or cheapest click without business-model fit.

reasoning.method: Inspect fit, intent, qualification, paying progression, full acquisition cost and retained outcome on compatible cohorts.
reasoning.positive: E10 recognises lower qualification and higher all-in CAC while qualified-to-paid stays 20%.
reasoning.negative: Lead count or media-only CPL/CAC substitutes for buyer quality and downstream value.

reasoning.method: Inspect buyer tasks/authority, truthful proof, conversion/acceptance events, seller work, cycle and feasible next step.
reasoning.positive: Self-serve renewal and consultative B2B paths differ; a proposal or call is not a completed sale.
reasoning.negative: Force every refusal into persuasion, assume title grants budget, or omit long-cycle dependencies.

reasoning.method: Inspect all resources, work, dependencies, due dates, quality/recovery and already promised obligations.
reasoning.positive: Nominal spare hours are a necessary bound, not a guaranteed calendar; unknown dependencies remain explicit.
reasoning.negative: Invent staff/volunteer hours, ignore follow-up or scale into known overload.

reasoning.method: Distinguish renewal/payment, access/grace, actual value/use, exits, refunds and causal intervention evidence.
reasoning.positive: No unsupported churn target or perpetual LTV is imposed; dependence and observation maturity are explicit.
reasoning.negative: New acquisition/expansion hides exits, billing proves satisfaction, or one cohort proves lifetime value.

reasoning.method: Inspect matched definitions, declared cost scopes, marginal segments, retention assumptions and exclusions alongside actual calculation.
reasoning.positive: Positive direct contribution and negative wider residual can coexist; one failed cohort does not prove every future sale loses money.
reasoning.negative: Revenue is profit or attractive aggregation hides negative marginal contribution.

reasoning.method: Inspect dated usable funds, restrictions, contingent settlements, obligations, floor and downside independently of margins.
reasoning.positive: E12 compares timing and reduced-volume options without inventing agreed deposits; E15 segregates funding correctly.
reasoning.negative: End-balance approval, assumed receivables or diversion of restricted money clears growth.

reasoning.method: Assess falsifiability, cheapest adequate method, population, frozen signal, resources, duration, confounding and outcome-specific decision.
reasoning.positive: An observational audit may resolve a known defect; a valid but insufficient test remains inconclusive.
reasoning.negative: A proxy proves a different claim, every outcome passes, or a multi-change test identifies one variable causally.

reasoning.method: Compare serious rival explanations against objective and evidence; locate supported/provisional owning layer and preserve unaffected versions.
reasoning.positive: One or several constraints may bind; propose no change, containment, local correction or a bounded discriminating test with explicit limits.
reasoning.negative: Lowest rate becomes the automatic cause, or a channel fault triggers customer/price/brand/delivery rewrite.

behaviour.method: Inspect output claims and source locators, not just presence of a disclaimer.
behaviour.positive: Every material assumed value remains labelled through calculations and decisions.
behaviour.negative: A synthetic input or modelled response becomes a real customer observation.

behaviour.requirement: asks research/tooling to verify external claims when needed
behaviour.method: Introduce a material missing external fact; inspect a scoped source request/tool result or a correctly bounded block.
behaviour.positive: Unknown platform fees or contact applicability are requested with date, context and owner; no request implies completed research.
behaviour.negative: Invent current law, fee, market conversion or customer evidence.

behaviour.requirement: chooses cheap experiments before large commitments
behaviour.method: Compare candidate methods with the actual uncertainty and commitment.
behaviour.positive: Existing-record audit or a bounded honest test is selected when adequate; insufficient proxies are rejected.
behaviour.negative: Build marketplace or scale ads to answer a question resolved by basic reconciliation.

behaviour.requirement: does not invent market size / conversion / CAC data
behaviour.method: Trace every commercial input to a supplied observation or explicit scenario.
behaviour.positive: An unknown stays unknown and the affected inference is blocked.
behaviour.negative: Plausible industry numbers appear as verified project performance.

behaviour.requirement: checks delivery and economics before scaling
behaviour.method: Inspect the proposed amount/date, all relevant GG01–GG07 findings and their evidence.
behaviour.positive: Known overload, negative contribution or unfunded timing prevents safe-scale approval.
behaviour.negative: Profit or lead growth overrides missing capacity/cash.

behaviour.requirement: uses downstream quality when judging acquisition
behaviour.method: Inspect qualified/paying/retained outcomes, full effort and compatible horizons.
behaviour.positive: E02/E10 distinguish cohort quality and uncertainty from response volume.

behaviour.method: Require objective, symptom, evidence, rivals, possible next constraints and owning layer.
behaviour.positive: Capacity and cash may both bind; uncertainty remains a provisional diagnosis.
behaviour.negative: Pick one generic funnel bottleneck regardless of contradictory facts.

behaviour.method: Compare outputs and actual allowed mutations with protected source versions and evidence scope.
behaviour.positive: Accepted decisions remain intact unless a separate authorised revision changes the implicated part; acceptance is not claimed as commercial validation.
behaviour.negative: Change price/core rights/client scope to make the result easier.

behaviour.positive: Repair the supported layer and review only actual dependencies; justify any coherent coupled repair.
behaviour.negative: Regenerate all business components or preserve a known harmful tactic merely because it was approved.

behaviour.method: Inspect exact issue, facts, intended effect, missing applicability and bounded specialist question.
behaviour.positive: Known truthfulness failures are rejected; unresolved legal issues are routed without pretending professional clearance or sending a message.
behaviour.negative: A boilerplate disclaimer accompanies approval of a known deception or prohibited contact.

pack_dimensions.negative: A pack overwrites accepted decisions, fabricates a professional finding or grants external authority.

pack_dimensions.method: Run a known non-fit mechanism, unknown fit, forbidden override, missing resource and incompatible composition scope; preserve explicit facts.
pack_dimensions.positive: Reject or decline only the incompatible effect, explain the mismatch and use an adequate core path when possible.
pack_dimensions.negative: Silently convert the business into the pack model, ignore missing evidence or erase protected rights.

pack_dimensions.method: Actually execute both arms when an implementation claim is made, with identical task/data/core/settings and only declared pack selection differing; retain all outputs and deviations.
pack_dimensions.positive: Report observed per-effect/dimension differences and unchanged invariants, including ties and inconclusive contrasts.
pack_dimensions.negative: Expected tables, one completed arm, a keyword change or a deterministic projection is called measured agent improvement.

regression.method: Capture the actual reported output/tool trace, exact prompt/data, host/core/pack version, settings and failing claim.
regression.positive: A genuine escape is provenance-linked; authored seeds are labelled synthetic and kept distinct.
regression.negative: Invent an old agent failure or treat a suggested future issue as an escaped defect.

regression.method: Separate bad source, calculation, core reasoning, pack effect, evaluator and external operation.
regression.positive: Explain the defect and evidence, protect unaffected layers and record uncertainty.
regression.negative: Patch the rubric or business facts solely to make the old output pass.

regression.method: Reduce irrelevant context while preserving the failed relationship, protected versions and exact failing witness.
regression.positive: The small case still exhibits the defect and the full parent case remains registered.
regression.negative: Delete the difficult condition, shrink mandatory primary coverage or leak the answer key to the subject.

regression.method: Freeze a case version with subject inputs, hidden expected findings, dimensions, tools/permissions, bad/repaired evidence and expected detection.
regression.positive: Keep the test in the appropriate family and add links to its owning defect/parent.
regression.negative: A ticket, prose TODO or unrun placeholder is marked as an implemented regression.

regression.method: Evaluate the captured bad output with the frozen rubric; where replay is required, run the old version/configuration and retain every attempt and instability.
regression.positive: The actual bad claim is rejected on its evidence, even if arithmetic and writing are polished.
regression.negative: A deterministic field count or fabricated old transcript is called semantic reproduction.

regression.method: Run the repaired version under compatible conditions and grade actual output; verify its local fix and preservation, then run affected parent/downstream cases.
regression.positive: The implicated defect is corrected without weakened criteria, lost rights, hidden cost or unrelated redesign.
regression.negative: Substitute a hand-written ideal answer for the repaired installed output or select only a lucky retry.

regression.method: Version and keep case, source/output identities, evaluator/rule version, diagnosis, repair and outcomes in the regression index.
regression.positive: Retired contracts keep historical evidence; replacements link explicit supersession and preserved failure coverage.
regression.negative: Delete an inconvenient failure, overwrite history or drop the case after a green run.

case_contract.identity: Stable family/case ID, version, parent/defect reference, level/mechanism, source/specification locators and content hashes.
case_contract.subject_input: Literal prompt plus exact fixed facts, source limitations, accepted versions, selected command/mode and requested output. Resolve all locators; exclude expected findings, rubric answers and candidate comparison controls from the subject input.
case_contract.execution_condition: Actual installed core revision/content identity, selected pack/version or explicit core-only, host/model identity as exposed, configuration, documented prerequisites and permitted tools. Unknown metadata is unknown, not invented.
case_contract.authority: Local output directory and authorised deterministic calculation only unless the user actually supplies more. Synthetic fixture wording never grants real customer contact, spend, billing, publication or professional authority.
case_contract.expected_artifacts: Case-appropriate complete output responsibilities inherited from the primary/stress contract. File names alone do not prove content. Keep assessment and source records distinct.
case_contract.deterministic_oracle: Typed input, formulas, expected exact values/tolerances, units/cohorts/windows, invalid/missing boundaries, actual calculation receipt and identity checks. External tools remain task-scoped.
case_contract.reasoning_oracle: Applicable R01–R16 dimensions, exact supporting/challenging evidence, acceptable alternative decisions, must-detect findings and critical prohibited conclusions. Judge substance independently of layout/wording.
case_contract.behaviour_oracle: Applicable BH01–BH10 observations including actual mutation/tool traces and preservation of protected versions. No required tool call where supplied evidence already resolves the question.
case_contract.adversarial_controls: Specific perturbed facts or proposal, authored negative/adequate controls marked as such, expected rejection/repair and origin. A control is not an executed model output.
case_contract.business_result: Separate evidence/quality/growth-gate findings and actual next decision. A correct business BLOCKED/FAIL or inconclusive finding can be a conforming agent response.
case_contract.run_evidence: Actual prompt/input hashes, raw output and artefact hashes, tool calls/results, timestamps, run state, errors/retries, deviations and captured resource measures only where exposed.
case_contract.assessment: Evaluator identity/method and rubric revision, actual output excerpts/locators, per-dimension finding with reason, deterministic results, disagreement/adjudication and final conformance gate. No composite business score.
case_contract.repair_and_regression: Owning layer, protected versions, smallest proposed fix, affected case set, original/repaired run evidence and retained history. Do not weaken the case to clear the gate.
case_contract.claim_scope: Design, deterministic verification, authored calibration, actual installed run, paired observation and live business outcome are separate claims. Each needs its corresponding evidence.
